newsitem.title: USA: Terra Nitrogen sets cash distribution.
newsitem.headline: Terra Nitrogen sets cash distribution.

text.p: Terra Nitrogen Co LP said Thursday that a cash distribution of $0.895 per common unit will be paid April 30, 1997 to common unitholders of record as of April 18, 1997.

This distribution is the second part of the cash distribution announced in January, representing the balance of available cash for the fourth quarter of 1996, the nitrogen fertilizer products maker said.

As of March 31, 1997 -- the conclusion of the three-month period during which senior preference unitholders could convert their units into common units -- 13.3 million senior units had converted into common units, the company said.
These units, combined with the 5.2 million common units held by the general partner, Terra Nitrogen Corp, bring the total number of common units in the partnership to 18.5 million, the company said.

The 307,202 senior preference units that did not convert to common units will be redeemed on May 27, 1997 for $22.105 per unit, which includes a $0.605 distribution per unit for the first quarter of 1997, the company said.
Terra Nitrogen shares closed up 3/8 at 42-1/8 Thursday.
